The '''Incinerator room''' was an area of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] frequented by [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]]. The room was littered with scrap and broken droids. An incinerator was located at the back of the room at the end of a conveyor belt. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] discovered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] remains here, finding the Ugnaughts unwilling to allow him to take possession of the unfortunate droid.<ref name="TESB" />
